categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The tree customers browse. Reorder or archive it without breaking a link.
categories.tableCaption: Categories, in the order customers see them
categories.reorderHelpBody: Drag a row by its handle, or use the up and down buttons on any row. Both save the whole order for that group.

empty.title: Add your first category
empty.body: Categories are how customers find their way around the collection — bridal, formal, festive. Every piece belongs to one.

form.createBody: Give it a name customers will recognise. You can add a cover image once it exists.
form.editBody: Renaming keeps the existing link working. Changing the slug does not.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Shown to customers on the browse screen.
form.nameRequired: Give the category a name customers will recognise.
form.nameTooLong: Keep the name to 80 characters or fewer.
form.nameUrHint: Shown to customers reading in Urdu. Leave it blank to use the English name.
form.slugHint: The part of the address customers see. Changing it breaks any link already shared.
form.slugShape: Use lowercase words separated by single hyphens, like bridal-lehenga.
form.parentHint: Categories go one level deep, so a sub-category can't have children of its own.
form.parentLocked: This category has sub-categories, so it stays at the top level.
form.coverReplaceReady: New cover ready — save to apply
form.coverHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB.
form.coverAfterCreate: Add a cover image once the category exists — the upload is filed under it.

delete.title: Delete {name}
delete.body: This removes {name} from the tree for good. Pieces filed under it keep their history but will need a new category.
delete.mismatch: The name doesn't match yet. Type it exactly as shown above.
delete.blockedBody: {count, plural, one {It holds # published piece.} other {It holds # published pieces.}} A category that customers can still browse into can't be removed.
delete.archiveInsteadBody: Archiving takes it off the storefront and leaves every piece where it is. You can restore it at any time.
delete.alreadyArchived: It is already archived, so customers can't browse into it. Move its pieces to another category to delete it.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Every piece, its publish state and its photo health.
catalog.rowsLabel: Catalog rows. Press j and k to move, Enter to open.
catalog.selectAll: Select every piece on this page
catalog.resultCount: {total, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} · page {page} of {pages}

empty.title: Add your first piece
empty.body: A piece needs a title, a category, a price and one photograph before it can go live. It takes about two minutes.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches these filters
noMatches.body: Widen the search, or clear the filters to see the whole catalog.

toast.publishBlockedHint: Open the piece to see what it still needs.

firstRun.title: From an empty catalog to your first live piece
firstRun.body: Five steps. Each one takes you straight to the screen that does it.

photo.label: Add photographs
photo.description: One of them is the try-on source.

testRender.label: Run a test render
testRender.description: See it on a reference model, then approve it.

publish.label: Publish
publish.description: The piece goes on the storefront.

quality.label: Photo quality
quality.notCheckedBody: The photo check runs on the try-on source.
quality.notCheckedHint: Mark one of the photographs as the try-on source and the check runs straight away.
quality.sectionDescription: The try-on source is checked against five things the model needs. The pass mark is {minScore}.
quality.needsBetterPhotoBody: Change what the checks below name and this clears on its own. Until then the piece can't go live.
quality.overriddenBody: An override was recorded on {when}, so this piece can go live with this photograph. The score has not changed.
quality.readyTitle: This photograph is ready for try-on
quality.readyBody: It passes every check, so nothing here blocks publishing.
quality.overrideExplainer: {count, plural, one {The check above is what the model needs.} other {The # checks above are what the model needs.}} Re-shooting or re-exporting is the fix. If the photograph genuinely cannot be replaced, an override lets this piece go live and is written to the audit log.

override.title: Publish {title} with this photograph?
override.body: It scores {score} against a pass mark of {minScore}.
override.consequenceFailedChecks: {count, plural, one {The piece goes live with # failing photo check.} other {The piece goes live with # failing photo checks.}}
override.consequenceConsumers: Customers trying it on will see more failed try-ons than usual.
override.consequenceAudit: The override is written to the audit log under your name, with the reason you give below.
override.reasonLabel: Why this piece may go live below the bar
override.reasonPlaceholder: Archive piece — the only surviving photograph, a reshoot isn't possible.
override.reasonHint: At least {min} characters. This is what the audit log records.
override.reasonTooShort: Say why in a sentence — this is the only record of the decision.

identity.title: The piece
identity.description: What it is called, how it is coded, and where it sits.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What customers filter and read by.

pricing.title: Price
pricing.description: Whether it sells or rents, and what that costs.

placeholders.title: Zarrin bridal lehenga
placeholders.description: What the piece is, in a sentence or two.

hints.title: Shown to customers on the storefront.
hints.titleUr: Leave it blank to use the English title.
hints.sku: Your own stock code. It has to be unique across live pieces.
hints.slug: The part of the address customers see. It fills itself in from the title.
hints.category: Archived categories aren't offered — pieces can't be filed under one.
hints.colors: Press Enter after each colour. Customers filter by these.
hints.styleTags: Press Enter after each tag. These feed search.
hints.embellishment: How heavy the work is. Customers filter by this.
hints.description: Fabric, work, occasion. Two or three sentences is plenty.
hints.price: In major units, with up to two decimal places.
hints.deposit: Held against the rental and returned afterwards.
hints.depositSaleOnly: A deposit only applies to a rental.

errors.skuRequired: Give the piece a stock code.
errors.titleRequired: Give the piece a title customers will recognise.
errors.categoryRequired: Choose the category this piece belongs to.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number, with up to two decimal places.
errors.depositRequired: A rental needs a deposit. Enter the amount held against it.
errors.depositInvalid: Enter the deposit as a number, with up to two decimal places.

SALE.label: Sale
SALE.description: The customer buys it. No deposit applies.

RENTAL.label: Rental
RENTAL.description: The customer borrows it. A deposit is required.

form.depositNoticeBody: Deposits only apply to rentals, so this piece won't carry one. Switch it to a rental and the deposit field comes back.

images.sectionDescription: One photograph is the try-on source. The rest are the gallery customers scroll.
images.dropzoneBrowse: Drop them here, or choose files
images.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to {size} each, {max} in total.
images.atCapacityBody: A piece holds up to {max} photographs. Remove one to add another.
images.empty: No photographs yet. Drop the first one above — the piece can't go live without one.
images.noSourceBody: Mark one photograph as the try-on source. It is the image the model works from, and the piece can't go live without it.
images.altPlaceholder: Deep red lehenga with gold zari on the hem
images.cannotDeleteLiveSource: The try-on source of a live piece can't be deleted. Take the piece down first, or mark another photograph as the source.

toast.sourceSetHint: The test render has been reset, so this piece needs a fresh one approved before it can go live.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this photograph
deleteDialog.body: It is removed from the gallery for good.
deleteDialog.sourceBody: This is the try-on source. Deleting it leaves {title} without one, and it can't go live until another is chosen.
deleteDialog.mismatch: The title doesn't match yet. Type it exactly as shown above.

publish.sectionDescription: What this piece still needs, and what happens next.
publish.blockedTitle: {count, plural, one {One thing worth sorting first} other {# things worth sorting first}}
publish.blockedBody: You can publish anyway. These are recommendations, and whichever you skip is recorded against your name in the audit log.

source.title: No try-on source photograph
source.body: Add a photograph and mark it as the try-on source. Without one this piece will appear in the catalog but fail when a customer tries it on.

testRender.title: No approved test render
testRender.none: Run a test render and approve it. This is how we know the piece works on a body before a customer sees it.
testRender.pending: A test render is waiting for your decision. Approve it, or send it back with a reason.
testRender.rejected: The last test render was sent back. Change the photograph or run another, then approve it.

quality.title: The photograph is below the quality bar
quality.body: It scores {score}. Change what the photo report names, or record an override with a reason.

publish.readyBody: Every check has passed. Publishing puts this piece on the storefront and makes it available to try on.
publish.overriddenBody: An override was recorded on {when}. The photograph still fails its checks, and customers may see more failed try-ons from this piece.
publish.archiveVsDelete: Archiving keeps the piece and its history and takes it off the storefront. Deleting keeps the history but removes the piece from the catalog.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {title}
deleteDialog.body: The piece leaves the catalog. Its try-on history stays in analytics, and its SKU and slug become free to reuse.
deleteDialog.mismatch: The title doesn't match yet. Type it exactly as shown above.

editor.metaDescription: Details, photographs, the photo report and the test render.

toast.rolledBack: Your changes have been put back the way they were.

new.title: Add a piece
new.description: Details and photographs together. The piece goes live the moment you save.
new.photosNextBody: Save the details and the piece opens ready for its photographs. Uploads are filed against a piece, so it has to exist first.

noCategories.title: Make a category first
noCategories.body: Every piece belongs to a category, and there are none yet. It takes a moment.

toast.createdHint: It is live in the collection.
toast.imagesFailed: {count, plural, one {1 photograph} other {# photographs}} did not upload — retry from the gallery below.

new.photosOnCreate: Chosen photographs upload when you save. The first one is the try-on source.

testRender.metaDescription: The render beside the source photograph. Approve it, or send it back with a reason.
testRender.title: Test render — {title}
testRender.description: The render sits beside the photograph it came from. Approving it is what lets this piece go live.
testRender.sourceDescription: The try-on source, as the model receives it.
testRender.renderDescription: The piece on a reference model.
testRender.notRunYet: No render yet. Run one below to see this piece on a reference model.

noSource.title: Add a try-on source first
noSource.body: A test render needs one photograph marked as the try-on source. Add a photograph to this piece and mark it.

run.title: Run a render
run.description: One render against one reference model.
run.modelHint: Reference models are the only person photographs we send upstream. A customer's photo is never used here.
run.costBody: One generation from the studio's monthly budget. It never touches a customer's allowance.

decision.title: Your decision
decision.description: Approving unblocks publishing. Sending it back keeps the piece off the storefront.
decision.approvedBody: This piece can now be published.
decision.rejectedBody: This piece stays off the storefront until a new render is approved.
decision.reasonPlaceholder: The drape falls wrong at the shoulder.
decision.reasonHint: Whoever picks this up next needs to know whether the photograph was wrong or the render was.
decision.reasonRequired: Say what was wrong with it — this is the only record of the decision.

toast.approvedHint: This piece can now be published.

bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# piece selected} other {# pieces selected}}
bulk.overRecordCap: Select {max} pieces or fewer to act on them together.
bulk.overRenderCap: Test renders run in batches of {max} or fewer.

confirm.namedWithRest: This affects {names} and {count, plural, one {# other piece} other {# other pieces}}.
confirm.destinationHint: Published pieces keep their state; the category counts move with them.

PUBLISH.title: {count, plural, one {Publish # piece} other {Publish # pieces}}
PUBLISH.body: Each piece goes through the same checks as publishing it on its own. Anything without an approved test render is left as it is and named in the report.

UNPUBLISH.title: {count, plural, one {Take down # piece} other {Take down # pieces}}
UNPUBLISH.body: They come off the storefront and go back to draft. Nothing is deleted and their history stays.

ARCHIVE.title: {count, plural, one {Archive # piece} other {Archive # pieces}}
ARCHIVE.body: They come off the storefront and out of the working catalog. Their try-on history stays in analytics.

RECATEGORISE.title: {count, plural, one {Move # piece} other {Move # pieces}}
RECATEGORISE.body: They move to the category you choose. Nothing else about them changes.

TEST_RENDER.title: {count, plural, one {Run a test render for # piece} other {Run test renders for # pieces}}
TEST_RENDER.body: Each one is a real generation against the studio's budget. Pieces that already have an approved render are skipped. The cost is below — check it before you start.

estimate.loading: Working out what this would cost…
estimate.title: {generations, plural, one {This run spends # generation} other {This run spends # generations}}
estimate.selected: {count, plural, one {# piece selected} other {# pieces selected}}
estimate.alreadyApproved: {count, plural, one {# already has an approved render and will be skipped} other {# already have an approved render and will be skipped}}
estimate.overBudget: This run would go past what's left. Reduce the selection, or wait for the budget to reset.

report.partialBody: Each one is named below with the reason. Nothing else in the selection was affected.

health.title: Catalog health
health.description: Pieces missing an approved test render, scoring low on photo quality, failing often, or going untried.
health.inspected: {count, plural, one {# piece checked} other {# pieces checked}}
health.truncatedBody: The catalog is larger than this screen sweeps, so these counts cover the {count} most recently edited pieces rather than everything.

allClear.title: Nothing needs attention
allClear.body: Every piece has an approved test render, passes its photo checks, and is being tried on.

missingTestRender.title: Missing a test render
missingTestRender.hint: Can't go live until one is approved
missingTestRender.description: These pieces have no approved test render, so they can't be published.

lowQualityScore.title: Low photo quality
lowQualityScore.description: The try-on source scores below the pass mark of {minScore}. The photo report on each piece says what to change.

elevatedFailureRate.title: Failing often
elevatedFailureRate.description: Customers are getting failed try-ons from these. Usually the photograph has more than one garment in frame.

zeroTryOnsIn30Days.title: Not being tried on
zeroTryOnsIn30Days.description: Live, but nobody has tried these on in {days} days. Worth checking where they sit in the collection.

consumers.title: Customers
consumers.description: Who has signed up, what they have tried on, and what they have asked about.
consumers.tableCaption: Customers, with their contact details, activity and account status

empty.title: No one has signed up yet
empty.body: Customers arrive by using the fitting room. Publish a few pieces and they will appear here as they join.

noMatches.title: No customer matches this view
noMatches.body: Try a different spelling, or widen the filters.

error.title: The customer list did not load

toast.activated: {name} is active and can sign in.

consumer.title: Customer
consumer.description: Her account, her shortlist and her enquiries. Her photos are never shown here.
consumer.next1: Renders appear only where she attached them to an enquiry.
consumer.next2: Quota, suspension and deletion, each with the confirmation it deserves.

enquiries.title: Enquiries
enquiries.description: The inbox. Anything untouched for a day is flagged.
enquiries.next1: The table, the stale highlight, and the status change in one click.
enquiries.next2: It works on a phone, because enquiries do not wait for a desk.

enquiry.title: Enquiry
enquiry.description: The pieces, the notes and the status.
enquiry.next1: The detail view with the attached renders and the customer’s message.
enquiry.next2: Notes are append-only, and WhatsApp opens with the message ready.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Flagged photos and renders, blurred until you choose to open one.
moderation.next1: The queue with blurred thumbnails and a deliberate reveal.
moderation.next2: Approve or reject, both audited, with the customer told what happened.

abuse.title: Abuse
abuse.description: Rate-limit hits, suspensions and blocked addresses.
abuse.next1: The list with what triggered each entry and when it expires.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: This month's generations, what they cost, and where the budget lands.
usage.next1: Burn rate and projection, with the warning threshold marked.
usage.next2: What happens when the budget runs out, stated before it does.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: The funnel, the pieces people try most, and why they pass.
analytics.next1: Funnel, leaderboard, rejection reasons, categories and activity.
analytics.next2: Every chart readable without colour alone, and every table exportable.

audit.title: Audit
audit.next1: The filterable log, append-only, with the actor and the action on each row.
audit.next2: No personal data and no storage keys ever appear in a log line.

team.title: Team
team.next1: Invite, resend and revoke, with the invitation single-use.
team.next2: The last active admin cannot be removed, and no one changes their own role.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Brand, quotas, budget and the toggles that shape the storefront.
settings.next1: The brand colour and logo, validated for contrast before they are accepted.
settings.next2: Quota and budget defaults, each with what it changes stated plainly.

tryonProvider.title: Try-on provider
tryonProvider.description: Which upstream renders every try-on. Switching applies to the next generation — no restart, and anything already running finishes on the provider it started on.

source.environment: {driver} is live, following the server default. No override is set.
source.override: {driver} is live, set here. It overrides the server default.

tryonProvider.notConfiguredHint: This provider has no credentials on this server yet. Add them to the API environment and restart before it can be selected.

confirm.title: Switch to {driver}?
confirm.billableBody: Every try-on from now on will be rendered by {driver} and charged to that account. Renders already made are kept, and you can switch back at any time.
confirm.mockBody: Try-ons will return placeholder renders and nothing will be charged. Consumers will see images that are not real try-ons, so use this only while testing or while an upstream is down.

empty.title: No providers available
empty.body: The server did not offer any try-on providers. Check the API configuration and reload.

errors.loadTitle: We could not load the provider settings
errors.loadBody: The list of try-on providers did not come back. Nothing has changed — try again in a moment.
errors.switchBody: The switch did not go through, so the previous provider is still live. Try again in a moment.
errors.notConfiguredBody: Its credentials are missing from this server, so it cannot be selected yet. The previous provider is still live.

tryonProvider.notSelectableHint: This is a placeholder provider — it returns images that are not real try-ons. It is live because the server was configured that way, and it cannot be chosen here. Pick a real provider above, or change TRYON_DRIVER on the server.

settingsPolicy.title: Policy
settingsPolicy.description: Publish a new version. Everyone is asked to agree again.
settingsPolicy.next1: The version list, the editor and the publish confirmation.
settingsPolicy.next2: Publishing is deliberate: it says how many people it will affect.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: See the customer experience without spending a generation.
preview.next1: The consumer shell rendered with sample data and generation disabled.
preview.next2: A clear marker that this is a preview, so it is never mistaken for live.

home.title: Console
home.description: Today's enquiries, catalog health and this month's usage.
home.next1: The enquiry inbox with the 24-hour flag, and catalog problems worth fixing.
home.next2: Budget burn and the projection, so a surprise never arrives as a surprise.

errors.description: That didn't go through. Try again — nothing you typed has been lost.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of these details need another look. The fields with a message below them are the ones to change.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. Your changes are still here — try again when you're back.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: That took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: That's a lot of requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND: That category is no longer in the tree. Refresh the page to see the current list.
errors.CATEGORY_HAS_PUBLISHED_GARMENTS: This category still holds published pieces, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead — it disappears from the storefront and the pieces stay where they are.
errors.CATEGORY_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: Categories go one level deep. Pick a top-level category as the parent, or move this one back to the top level first.
errors.CATEGORY_ARCHIVED: That category is archived, so new pieces can't be filed under it. Restore it, or choose another.
errors.GARMENT_NOT_FOUND: That piece is no longer in the catalog. Go back to the list to see what's there now.
errors.GARMENT_SKU_EXISTS: Another piece already uses this SKU. Give this one a different code.
errors.INVALID_PUBLISH_TRANSITION: That change isn't available from the piece's current state. Refresh the page to see where it stands.
errors.TRYON_SOURCE_REQUIRED: This piece has no try-on source photo yet. Add a photo and mark one as the try-on source.
errors.TRYON_SOURCE_ALREADY_SET: That photo is already the try-on source. Pick a different one to change it.
errors.TEST_RENDER_REQUIRED: This piece needs an approved test render before it can go live. Run one and approve it on the test render screen.
errors.GARMENT_QUALITY_BELOW_THRESHOLD: This photo is below the quality bar for try-on. The report lists what to change.
errors.QUALITY_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED: The photo is below the quality bar, so publishing needs a recorded override with a reason.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_SMALL: This image is too small for try-on. Re-export it at 2,000px or more on its longest side.
errors.IMAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: That file type isn't accepted. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: That file is larger than the upload limit. Export it again at a smaller size.
errors.IMAGE_CORRUPT: That file couldn't be read as an image. Export it again from the original.
errors.UPLOAD_TICKET_INVALID: That upload couldn't be matched to this piece. Choose the file again.
errors.UPLOAD_TICKET_EXPIRED: The upload took longer than the window allows. Choose the file again.
errors.BULK_OPERATION_PARTIAL_FAILURE: Some pieces went through and some didn't. The list below names each one.
errors.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: This month's generation budget is spent, so test renders are paused until it resets.
errors.UPSTREAM_NO_GARMENT_DETECTED: The model couldn't find a single garment in this photo. One piece per frame, filling most of it, works best.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: The model couldn't read this file. Re-export it as a JPEG or PNG.
errors.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: The render took too long to come back. Try it again.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The render service isn't answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED: The render service is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.MODERATION_REJECTED: That image didn't pass the automatic content check. Use a different photograph.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: That account is no longer here. Refresh the list to see who is.
errors.RESOURCE_CONFLICT: The account moved before this went through — someone else may have just changed it. Refresh the list and look again.
errors.DELETION_IN_PROGRESS: This account is being deleted, so nothing more about it can change. The purge finishes within 24 hours.
